Fields.Name: Embed

Fields.Name: Lifetimes

Fields.Name: NetcatActiveSide
Fields.Description:
Which side actively establishes the netcat connection for `SSH+NETCAT` transport.

* `LOCAL`: Local system initiates the connection
* `REMOTE`: Remote system initiates the connection
* `null`: Not applicable for other transport types

Fields.Name: NetcatActiveSideListenAddress
Fields.Description: IP address for the active side to listen on for `SSH+NETCAT` transport. `null` if not applicable.

Fields.Name: NetcatActiveSidePortMax
Fields.Description: Maximum port number in the range for netcat connections. `null` if not applicable.

Fields.Name: NetcatActiveSidePortMin
Fields.Description: Minimum port number in the range for netcat connections. `null` if not applicable.

Fields.Name: NetcatPassiveSideConnectAddress
Fields.Description: IP address for the passive side to connect to for `SSH+NETCAT` transport. `null` if not applicable.

Fields.Name: OnlyMatchingSchedule
Fields.Description: Will only replicate snapshots that match `schedule` or `restrict_schedule`.

Fields.Name: PeriodicSnapshotTasks
Fields.Description: List of periodic snapshot task IDs that are sources of snapshots for this replication task. Only push     replication tasks can be bound to periodic snapshot tasks.

Fields.Name: Properties
Fields.Description: Send dataset properties along with snapshots.

Fields.Name: PropertiesExclude
Fields.Description: Array of dataset property names to exclude from replication.

Fields.Name: PropertiesOverride
Fields.Description: Object mapping dataset property names to override values during replication.

Fields.Name: Readonly
Fields.Description:
Controls destination datasets readonly property.

* `SET`: Set all destination datasets to readonly=on after finishing the replication.
* `REQUIRE`: Require all existing destination datasets to have readonly=on property.
* `IGNORE`: Avoid this kind of behavior.

Fields.Name: Recursive
Fields.Description: Whether to recursively replicate child datasets.

Fields.Name: Replicate
Fields.Description: Whether to use full ZFS replication.

Fields.Name: RestrictSchedule
Fields.Description: Restricts when replication task with bound periodic snapshot tasks runs. For example, you can have periodic     snapshot tasks that run every 15 minutes, but only run replication task every hour.

Fields.Name: RetentionPolicy
Fields.Description:
How to delete old snapshots on target side:

* `SOURCE`: Delete snapshots that are absent on source side.
* `CUSTOM`: Delete snapshots that are older than `lifetime_value` and `lifetime_unit`.
* `NONE`: Do not delete any snapshots.

Fields.Name: Retries
Fields.Description: Number of retries before considering replication failed.

Fields.Name: Schedule
Fields.Description: Schedule to run replication task. Only `auto` replication tasks without bound periodic snapshot tasks can have     a schedule.

Fields.Name: SourceDatasets
Fields.Description: List of datasets to replicate snapshots from.

Fields.Name: SpeedLimit
Fields.Description: Limits speed of SSH stream. Available only for SSH transport.

Fields.Name: SshCredentials
Fields.Description: Keychain Credential ID of type `SSH_CREDENTIALS`.

Fields.Name: Sudo
Fields.Description: `SSH` and `SSH+NETCAT` transports should use sudo (which is expected to be passwordless) to run `zfs`     command on the remote machine.

Fields.Name: TargetDataset
Fields.Description: Dataset to put snapshots into.

Fields.Name: Transport
Fields.Description:
Method of snapshots transfer.

* `SSH` transfers snapshots via SSH connection. This method is supported everywhere but does not achieve       great performance.
* `SSH+NETCAT` uses unencrypted connection for data transfer. This can only be used in trusted networks       and requires a port (specified by range from `netcat_active_side_port_min` to `netcat_active_side_port_max`)       to be open on `netcat_active_side`.
* `LOCAL` replicates to or from localhost.

* `SSH+NETCAT` uses unencrypted connection for data transfer. This can only be used in trusted networks       and requires a port (specified by range from `netcat_active_side_port_min` to `netcat_active_side_port_max`)       to be open on `netcat_active_side`.
* `LOCAL` replicates to or from localhost.

Constants.Name: CountEligibleManualSnapshotsTransport
Constants.Description: Transport method to use for accessing snapshots.

Constants.Name: ReplicationReadonly
Constants.Description:
Controls destination datasets readonly property.

* `SET`: Set all destination datasets to readonly=on after finishing the replication.
* `REQUIRE`: Require all existing destination datasets to have readonly=on property.
* `IGNORE`: Avoid this kind of behavior.

Constants.Name: ReplicationRetentionPolicy
Constants.Description:
How to delete old snapshots on target side:

* `SOURCE`: Delete snapshots that are absent on source side.
* `CUSTOM`: Delete snapshots that are older than `lifetime_value` and `lifetime_unit`.
* `NONE`: Do not delete any snapshots.
